reviews.text: I found what I was looking for, 10/10. Unfortunately, the woman who takes payments and barely attends to customers—she struggles to even say good morning—detracts from the experience. I feel sorry for her staff who have to put up with such poor treatment. 1/10

Terrible service. The woman at the register, who wears glasses, is incredibly rude; it's like she's doing you a favor. 🙄
But that's not the worst part. The worst part is that they overcharge you for products they don't give you. They tell you prices but charge you different ones, and when you complain, they blame it on you and tell you to check the price yourself. There's another shop on the same block that sells Sunny, and it's a thousand times better and cheaper. If they don't like selling, they shouldn't even open. 🤗
Terrible service if you buy here, be sure to get a good insurance policy.

Terrible service. I think the owners changed because the lady who used to work there was very friendly, but the last few times I've gone they don't even let you inside. Outside, there's a surly-looking guy who asks, "What are you looking for?" and rudely tells you the prices, but he won't let you in. As for the prices, I've also noticed that it's cheaper to buy things at the market now.
Hello, I would like to know if you only sell things for pets or if you also sell cat food, etc.

A store where you can find quality products has excellent employees who are very friendly. The prices are very good, and like everything else in the store, they're always busy, but they always provide good service to everyone. We hope they don't change. What we like is that they give us personalized advice, and we appreciate their help, support, and guidance. They're great guys, congratulations!

They overcharge you! Check your receipts carefully if you plan to buy there, because they ripped me off for about 300 pesos! It's a shame I only realized it when I was already far away, but it's not right. There's no communication or verification between the cashier and the person serving you, so if you don't check, the same thing will happen to you. Unfortunately, I won't be going there again and I won't recommend it.
Excellent place, great service and a wide variety of products! Highly recommended

I just went this past weekend, and as other reviews mention, they have a great selection and the best prices. You'd think you could find things cheaper at the market, but no, they have better prices here. They're short-staffed, but I prefer to wait a bit for the prices. Highly recommended.

It's a great store for buying fish and pet supplies. They have excellent prices, some of the best I'd say. They have a wide variety of everything: ceramic rings, large ceramic rings, water conditioner, siphons, mesh bags—they have all sorts of things for every need, including all kinds of food. You can even order via WhatsApp and they'll ship it to you. The only downside is that the store is short-staffed to provide better customer service, answer questions, deliver products, and give prices.
